svg.title: SQL Server migration: three phases of the deployed POC
svg.desc: Phase 1: SQL Server CDC through Debezium Server and SeaweedFS into PostgreSQL Data Vault, with a separate SQL object migration workstream. Phase 2: verified technical CDC purge, gated by archive evidence, checkpoints, retention and recovery checks. Phase 3: reusable PostgreSQL to S3 exports, with Airflow orchestration, RabbitMQ for one invoice app and direct SeaweedFS consumers. The phase numbers organize workstreams, not a mandatory runtime sequence.

g.text: GCP VM · Terraform · 4 vCPU / 12 GiB RAM
Three workstreams; cleanup is gated by evidence.
SQL objects: inventory → port → compare GetOrderUpdates
POC result: 48 technical CDC images removed; 5 business captures unchanged.
Schedule exports · verify S3 delivery · confirm application receipt
RabbitMQ notifications serve the invoice application only.
One SeaweedFS service, two buckets. Solid arrows: data / cleanup; dashed: orchestration / SQL migration.
Single-VM POC · production cutover is separate
